The background leading to the Rule, in short, is that the respondent No. 3 Sonali Bank as the plaintiff instituted a suit before Artha Rin Adalat Court, Dhaka against the petitioner for recovery of dues amounting to Taka 3,78,96,848.44 by enforcing mortgage. In that suit the respondent No. 3 bank filed an application under section 13(3) of the Artha Rin Ain, 2003 (in short Ain) and the suit was decreed against the defendant on that count on 25-6-2005, in preliminary form. Thereafter the respondent-bank put the decree into execution, which was registered as Artha Execution Case No. 659 of 2005. The Execution Case proceeded and continued up to 27-6-2001, when under section 33(1) of Ain the auction was fixed. The petitioner preferred an application under order 21, rule 83 of the Code of Civil Procedure read with section 57 of the Ain contending that he is willing to sell the mortgage property included in the schedule of the Execution Case (Annexure-D) in private negotiation. By the impugned order No. 42 dated 13-6-2011 the respondent No.2 Artha Rin Adalat, Dhaka rejected the said application against which the petitioner moved this Division and obtained the present Rule and stay. 

 7. Let us now digress to next aspect of the case. Time and again our Appellate and this Division came down heavily on the issue that when there is a specific provision in the Ain itself then the party in a case should take recourse to that specific law. Here in this case the petitioner filed an application under Order XXI Rule 82 of the Code of Civil Procedure read with section 57 of the Ain to sell the mortgage property in a private negotiation, which can be done under section 38 of the Ain very well. Instead of so doing the petitioner, circumvent the said provision of Ain by taking recourse to provision of Code of Civil Procedure. This propensity we deprecate. Certainly, this has been done as a cunning device only to delay the execution proceeding that started after passing of the decree passed back in the year 2005. That being the situation we are constrained to hold that this unhealthy trend should be taken into consideration rigidly.
